native_consumers.crossing_end_type_dependencies: Named handwritten dependency separation: Feature.type ignores crossing navigation contributions for a structurally selected owned-cross end while retaining ordinary adapter, ownership, metadata, typing and default guards. Redefinition queries validate canonical crossing endpoints without requiring whole transformation. Full generalization still rejects unassessed contribution graphs.
native_consumers.materialized_contribution_admission: Structural recognition checks exact binary ownership, one CrossSubsetting, specific endpoint and ordered other-end/owned-cross chain; ordinary providers consume only that assessed shape. The constructed chain receives no owning-Type contribution. Shared required-specialization computation gates owned-cross default selection and recognizes only expected implied typing/subsetting.
native_consumers.lazy_crossing_schedule: A concrete ConstructBinaryCrossing dependency propagates through scope and generalization queries to the document linker. The verified constructor edits only its unpublished graph; the linker rebuilds identity indices and retries. Repeated/no-progress requests and fragment use reject. Owned-cross specialization is also scheduled; featuring and complete dependency ordering remain open.
native_consumers.automatic_derived_endpoints: Source postprocessing validates canonical ownership for imported referencing_feature/crossing_feature delegates and does not store derived aliases. Existing mutation guards remain strict; diagnostics identify the offending element and field.
native_consumers.explicit_crossing_provider: Named handwritten structural admission over imported ownership and FeatureChaining contracts recognizes one explicit CrossSubsetting owning a nonempty chain. Pending targets remain ordinary linker dependencies; no completion flag is changed.
native_consumers.lazy_cross_specialization_schedule: ConstructCrossSpecialization propagates from generalization queries through existing resolution paths. One shared pending-obligation computation drives construction, provider admission and scheduling. The unpublished graph is edited transactionally, reindexed and retried; unresolved prerequisites remain errors, not empty contributions. No completion flags are set.
native_consumers.typed_query_prerequisites: The bounded Feature type/chain/generalization/cross-specialization slice carries typed field/construction requirements internally. Existing immutable Diagnostic wrappers remain. The linker authorizes only registered pending fields; malformed or unregistered references reject, and successful contributions are recorded after insertion. Full library evaluation context and other query families remain open.

normative.assessment: The binary unchained-input constructor establishes crossFeature = ownedCrossFeature. Pilot chain expansion for already chained inputs may violate that direct equality; compound inputs remain rejected pending normative assessment. This is an unresolved assessment, not a verified disagreement.
